prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as the figure, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, the camera set back far enough that the whole figure is visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on the figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

ONE real adult Pakistani person with the face of a beautiful woman, the face exactly the same tone as the body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, an iron ship's anchor, a gold square-sided cowbell, a silver pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver bracelets. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
Physique: the body of an extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. The head stays in correct proportion to the broad frame; the arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
Body Art: The bare skin is painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs), wide cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers the whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of the hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of the feet. The face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the hip.
Footwear: Extreme silver platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than the ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
